paragraphs: Rav Yitzchak, son of Rabbah bar bar Chana.

He lived in Rava’s time. In [Sukkah 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.43b.11) Rava says to him: “Scholar, come and I will tell you a fine teaching your father used to say.” He died before Abaye: [Yevamot 64b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.64b.16) relates that he married Chuma, daughter of Issi son of Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah, after her husband Rachava of Pumbedita died. He too died, and Abaye married her. He is not Rav Yitzchak bar bar Chana, as explained in that entry.[^1]

notes.text: Bar urya, “son of Torah,” is Rava’s address to Yitzchak. Rava then quotes Yitzchak’s father in Rabbi Elazar’s name. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2206&lang=en) includes the other Yitzchak’s notices under this heading, while Hyman treats them as two men.
